details.biography:
The Broken Anvil · Level 5 - The Journeymen · Seat 1, Front line

A grim Wall-veteran dwarf in plate who plants himself in the doorway and dares the enemy to try. Gruff, dutiful and fiercely protective; counts his allies after every fight and swears quietly until they are all accounted for. Left the Boldock Wall when his company was disbanded; the Keepers offered him a wall worth standing on: the people of Tariel.

In a fight

Wade in front, Challenge the biggest foe, open with Demoralise against a crowd (or Inspire if the party needs to hit), then hold the line so nothing reaches the casters.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities (from the printed sheet)

Demoralise (1/day, action). Up to 25 enemies who can see and hear you: -6 to Charisma checks, and each makes a Will save (DC 13) or has Disadvantage on ALL its attack rolls for 5 rounds (Boldock Wall-Forged Dread). Only one of Inspire, Embolden or Demoralise can run at a time.

Inspire (1/day, action). All friendly creatures in your presence (up to 50) have Advantage on their first attack roll each round for 5 rounds. Cannot run alongside Embolden or Demoralise.

Embolden (1/day, action). Allies within 30ft gain +1 Fortitude, +1 Reflex and +2 Will saves for 5 rounds. Cannot run alongside Inspire or Demoralise.

Challenge (1/encounter, part of an attack). Name one foe within 30ft that can hear you. It makes a Will save (DC 13) or has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you for 1 minute. Saved or not, you have Advantage on your first attack roll each round against it for that minute.

Birthright Mount. You own a fully outfitted light warhorse (15 HP, Hit Dice 2d10+4, war-trained). Mounted, its own attacks have Advantage. It waits at the dungeon mouth; horses do not do stairs.

Horsemanship. Ride, mount, dismount and control your horse in combat with no check. Cover, deflect, fall softly, leap and charge manoeuvres need a Dexterity check.

Siege Discipline (kit). Advantage on checks about fortifications, siege assessment, or coordinating soldiers in a defensive action (sizing up a barred door counts).

Code of Conduct. Courage, honour, loyalty, generosity, humility, faith, justice. Break it and you lose Inspire, Embolden and Demoralise until a sincere public atonement.

Darkvision. See in darkness out to 60ft as if it were normal light.

Dwarven resilience. Advantage on saves against poison; Resistance 5 to poison damage.

Stonecunning. Advantage on checks about stonework, underground construction or unusual stonework.

Stonebraced (1/long rest). Treat an incoming critical hit as a normal hit, or ignore being knocked down.

Craft: Armourer. Advantage on Armourer checks (free; not an NWP slot).

The Clan Weapon. Your +1 warhammer. Lose it and you have Disadvantage on Charisma checks with other dwarves until you recover it.

Dul Khagul. Advantage to identify clan lineage, weapon origin and traditions, and on saves against being charmed or persuaded against clan loyalty.

Training. Weapons: handaxe, battleaxe, warhammer, light crossbow, firearms. Armour: light, medium (the Knight adds all armour and shields).

Brute Force (General). +1 Strength (included). Advantage on Strength checks to break, force open or physically overpower an obstacle. A barred door is a Hard (DC 15) Strength check: you roll d20+3 with Advantage.

Toughness (General). +1 Constitution (included) and +1 Max HP per level (included). Advantage on Constitution checks.

Speed, Initiative and HP. Speed: 25ft (Dwarf; never reduced by armour or encumbrance) · Initiative: +0 · HP: d10: 1st level 10 + Con 3 = 13; levels 2-5: 4 x (6 + 3) = 36; Toughness +1 per level = +5. Total 54.

Armour Class on the sheet: 10 + 7 (Plate Mail) + 1 (magic) + 0 (Dex; Heavy armour) + 1 (Medium Steel Shield) = 19

Class Abilities

1st Level

Birthright Mount

  • Effect: In addition to starting money, knights begin play with a fully outfitted riding horse (saddle, blankets, saddlebags, bit and bridle, harness, horseshoes, 1 meal) that is a light warhorse (15 HP, Hit Dice 2d10+4; see Mounts & Beasts of Burden in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue).

Horsemanship (Dexterity)

  • Effect: Trained in all aspects of mounted combat with no check required: saddle, mount, ride, dismount; control the mount in combat; guide with the knees; stay in the saddle when the mount rears or bolts; assess horse quality.
  • Direct the mount to perform cover, deflect, fall softly, leap, and charge manoeuvres on a successful Dexterity check
  • When mounted on a war-trained horse, your mount's attacks have Advantage

Martial Bearing

  • Effect: Your melee weapon hits deal +1 damage per three Knight levels (minimum +1). Always on.

Command (Charisma)

  • Effect: Uses per day equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier (minimum 2), +1 more at 6th level and again at 12th. Spend a use as your action to give a Command; it lasts for the encounter. Only one Command is active at a time: a new one ends the last.
  • Inspire (the default Command): friendly creatures within your presence have Advantage on their first attack roll each round
  • Inspire affects up to 12 creatures at 1st level, 25 at 3rd, 50 at 5th, 250 at 7th, 1,000 at 9th, 5,000 at 12th, 20,000 at 16th

2nd Level

Challenge

  • Effect: Once per encounter, as part of an attack, name one foe within 30ft that can hear you.
  • It makes a Will save against your Class Save DC, or has Disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but you for 1 minute.
  • Whether or not it saves, you have Advantage on your first attack roll each round against it for that minute.

3rd Level

Command: Embolden

  • Effect: A new Command option: companions and followers within 30ft have Advantage on Will saves.

4th Level

Rallying Cry

  • Effect: Any Command you give also ends the Frightened and Charmed conditions on allies within 30ft who can hear you.

5th Level

Command: Demoralise

  • Effect: A new Command option: enemies who can see you have Disadvantage on Charisma checks, and must make a Will save against your Class Save DC or have Disadvantage on their first attack roll each round.
  • Affects up to 25 creatures at 5th, 100 at 7th, 250 at 9th, 1,000 at 12th, 5,000 at 16th

6th Level

Honour Attack

  • Effect: Your first attack roll each round against your Challenged foe treats its AC as lower by your Charisma modifier. Always on.
  • 17th level: once per encounter, your first hit on your Challenged foe doubles the weapon's damage dice (flat modifiers are not doubled)

7th Level

Extra Attack

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).

8th Level

Battlefield Dominance

  • Effect: You can give a Command as part of an attack instead of as your action, and keep two different Commands active at once.

9th Level

Command: Expert in Arms

  • Effect: A new Command option: allies within 40ft have Advantage on contested manoeuvre checks. Unlike other Commands, it lasts only until the start of your next turn.
  • Allies who do not follow the knight's orders do not receive the Advantage

10th Level

Call-to-Arms

  • Effect: By establishing a stronghold, attract 2d10 followers of 0-level every month.
  • For every 40 followers, a 1st level knight also heeds the call. When 80 followers are gathered, a 5th level knight arrives
  • Followers must be paid or they leave (0-level: 6 gp/month; a knight follower: 40 gp/month per Level)

11th Level

Champion's Reckoning

  • Effect: A foe that fails its save against your Challenge is also Cowed: it cannot willingly move away from you unless it succeeds on a Wisdom check each round.
  • A creature immune to fear is immune to this effect

13th Level

Undying Reputation

  • Effect: Once per day, when reduced below half HP in combat witnessed by at least one ally or enemy, gain temporary HP equal to your Knight level + your Charisma modifier.
  • 24th level: the temporary HP equals twice your Knight level + your Charisma modifier, and you have Advantage on your first attack roll each round until the encounter ends

15th Level

  • Charisma Bonus: permanent +1 Charisma

19th Level

Banner Bearer

  • Effect: Your Command range doubles, and allies feel your Commands even when they can't see you.

20th Level

Battle Lord

  • Effect: The knight's Charisma bonus applies to the damage rolls and morale checks of allied troops in mass combat. Allied troops gain +1 AC and +1 to morale checks as long as they can see the knight fighting.
  • Troops must make a morale roll if the knight leaves or dies, suffering -4 to the check
  • Does not affect player characters

21st Level

Conversion to Knighthood

  • Effect: Confer knighthood upon a chosen NPC. NPCs without classes become 1st level knights bound to the granting knight (must obey and follow the code, or the knight strips their title).
  • NPCs with classes choose to continue in their class or become a multiclassed knight
  • Converted knights gain a permanent +1 to AC and +1 damage

24th Level

  • Battle Lord improves: mass combat bonus now equals double the Charisma bonus, and allied troops gain +2 AC and +2 to morale checks

Path of Greatness

  • Effect: Choose to become legendary. The knight may never back down from a fight or challenge. When fighting stronger opponents, have Advantage on your first attack roll each round and gain the Level difference as a bonus to damage.
  • Creatures of animal intelligence or lower, or anyone up to half the knight's level, must make a Will save or shun the knight
  • Once per month, alter weather as the Control Weather spell (cast as a 10th level caster)
  • Friends and allies who can see the knight never suffer poor morale so long as the knight remains on the field
  • Cowardice, retreating or fleeing certain death voids the Path for good: the knight loses it and every Knight ability from 20th level up, keeping HP and BtH

Kits: Knightly Orders and Traditions

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Knight folder. Drag one onto your character.

Knight Kits represent the order, tradition, or circumstance in which the character earned their spurs.
